# Privacy Policy (directory edition)

This edition of Patent Tools is one skill made of Markdown instructions and
reference images. It contains no programs and no servers.

## Data collection

None. The plugin has no servers, accounts, analytics, telemetry or tracking.
It never contacts the plugin author or any other service.

## Use and storage

Your invention content (descriptions, claims, sketches and the figures
Claude draws) stays in your conversation with Claude and in the files you
ask Claude to create in your own working directory. The skill tells Claude
to treat it as confidential and not to send it to web search or any outside
service without your explicit permission.

## Third-party sharing

The plugin shares nothing with anyone. How Claude itself handles your
conversations is covered by Anthropic's privacy policy.

## Data retention

The plugin keeps nothing beyond the files you ask it to create or edit.

## Contact

Questions or privacy concerns: open an issue at
https://github.com/Beginnerinvestorhub/patent-tools/issues.

*Last updated: 2026-11-22*
